name: spreadsheets
description: XLSX spreadsheet production skills and an Excel viewer panel, published as an official ZCode plugin.

description_i18n.en: Spreadsheet skills for XLSX: create, edit, analyze, chart, and convert workbooks. View workbooks in a side panel: reference cells in chat, and the agent can read, search, point at and capture them.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 XLSX 的电子表格技能：创建、编辑、分析、图表与格式转换；并可在侧栏查看工作簿，把单元格引用到对话，Agent 可以阅读、搜索、定位高亮并截取画面。
